reason: Free listing I'd happily take since you load the flyers for me, but I fill my nights through my WhatsApp list and regulars, so I wouldn't pay a monthly fee for an app nobody I know uses yet.
objection: I don't see who in my town would actually open this app. My crowd comes from PR and WhatsApp, and 39 euro a month is real money on my income if the nights are already full without it.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing a real, published number of local users and a couple of bars near me who got people through the door from it.
